$comment: Relative Markdown links that scripts/check_links.py should not fail on. Every entry needs a reason. Vendored content is the usual case: a placeholder in an upstream file cannot be fixed here without forking it, so it is exempted by exact path rather than by loosening the checker.

exempt.reason: Upstream template placeholder: a Markdown link whose target is the literal word url, inside an example line an agent is meant to fill in. Vendored verbatim from backnotprop/pstack, so it is exempted here rather than edited.
